The edge node's address, and a pairing code made on it in System, Edge Clients. A code pairs one node, once, before it expires.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 边缘节点的地址，以及在其系统、边缘客户端中生成的配对码。一个码在过期前只配对一个节点、一次。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The edge node's web certificate checked out, and it told this link key fingerprint over it. Next pairs and pins it: this node then links only to that key, and the edge node only to this node's own new key. A renewed web certificate does not change it.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 边缘节点的 Web 证书已核验，并经该证书告知了此链路密钥指纹。下一步会配对并固定它：此后此节点只链接该密钥，边缘节点只链接此节点自己的新密钥。续签 Web 证书不会改变这一点。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The edge node's XMPP tunnels go to another local node (edge_xmpp_node)
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 边缘节点的 XMPP 隧道通向另一个本地节点（edge_xmpp_node）

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The editor and JSON describe the same query. Save the rule to keep changes.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 编辑器和 JSON 描述的是同一查询。保存规则以保留更改。
嵌入式集群的数据源配置

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The emergency stop is on: no recovery action runs or starts.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 紧急停止已开启：不会运行或开始任何恢复操作。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The emergency stop is on: no recovery action runs.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 紧急停止已开启：不会运行任何恢复操作。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The first 1,000 errors; the error file has every failed row.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 前 1,000 个错误；错误文件包含每一行失败记录。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The first enabled matching policy applies.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 应用第一条已启用的匹配策略。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The foreign keys of the snapshot's tables are dropped, the snapshot imported on a worker, and the keys made again after it, as database jobs (DATABASE_ADMIN)
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 先删除快照所涉表的外键，在工作者上导入快照，之后再重建这些键，作为数据库作业（DATABASE_ADMIN）

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The frontend's sign-in callback, such as https://forum.example.com/account/Sso
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 前端的登录回调，例如 https://forum.example.com/account/Sso

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The instance identity of this release is uncertain, so its regressions may mix instances.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此发布的实例身份不确定，因此其回归可能混有多个实例。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The last batch the edge node acknowledged in this epoch
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 边缘节点在此纪元中确认的上一批

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The latest state of each evaluated rule and series. No data and Error mean health is unknown, never Normal.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 每条已评估规则和序列的最新状态。无数据和错误表示健康未知，从不是正常。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The link comes up a few seconds after pairing. Try again then, or see the link's state.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 配对后几秒链路才会建立。请到时重试，或查看链路状态。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The local node's full send these records follow
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 这些记录所跟随的本地节点完整发送

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The new rule gets the next unused id. Its text is in the default language; translate it afterwards.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 新规则获得下一个未用的 id。其文本使用默认语言；之后再翻译。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The PASS sites the edge node serves, separated by commas
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 边缘节点提供的 PASS 站点，用逗号分隔

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The path of a PEM file of the authorities to trust
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 要信任的颁发机构 PEM 文件的路径

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The policy file cannot be used, so no origin is trusted: ${policy.problem}
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 策略文件无法使用，因此不信任任何来源：${policy.problem}

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The public names the edge node answers for this node
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 边缘节点为此节点应答的公开名称

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此边缘节点为其本地节点应答的公开名称。透传名称的 TLS 原样到达本地节点；终结名称的请求会被转发。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The recorded end time cannot be read. Inspect the results and diagnostic links.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 无法读取已记录的结束时间。请查看结果和诊断链接。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The records of this document open in the data grid, where they can be filtered, sorted, exported and kept as saved views.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此文档的记录在数据表格中打开，可以在那里筛选、排序、导出并保存为视图。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The search could not run. Correct the query and search again.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 搜索未能运行。请改正查询后再次搜索。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The service job scheduler is not running.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 服务作业调度器未在运行。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The SHA-256 of the edge node's link key, pinned at pairing; a renewed web certificate does not change it
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 边缘节点链路密钥的 SHA-256，在配对时固定；续签 Web 证书不会改变它

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The SHA-256 of the edge node's link key, the key its links use
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 边缘节点链路密钥的 SHA-256，即其链路使用的密钥

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The SHA-256 of this edge node's link key. A local node shows it in its Pair step before it pairs: check that the two match
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此边缘节点链路密钥的 SHA-256。本地节点在配对前的配对步骤中显示它：请核对两者一致

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The snapshot is one file, not one per entity: every foreign key of the database is dropped around it
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 快照是单个文件，而不是每个实体一个：在其前后会删除数据库的全部外键

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The start of the SHA-256 of the node's key, pinned at pairing
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 节点密钥 SHA-256 的开头，在配对时固定

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The system's mail has a server of its own now. Choose it to go through the edge node instead; unpairing puts the server back.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 系统邮件现在有自己的服务器。选择它改为经边缘节点；取消配对会把服务器改回去。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The test did not pass: go back to fix the setup, or choose Continue anyway
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 测试未通过：返回以修正设置，或选择仍要继续

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The type, host, port, user or TLS settings changed, so the stored password was cleared: enter it again
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 类型、主机、端口、用户或 TLS 设置已更改，因此已清除保存的密码：请重新输入

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: These texts have no ${preview.locale ?? locale} translation and come from another language:
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 这些文本没有 ${preview.locale ?? locale} 翻译，来自另一种语言：

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This build has no edge link. The Maximal and Enterprise packages have it.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此构建没有边缘链路。Maximal 和 Enterprise 包包含它。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This edge node takes no links
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此边缘节点不接受链路

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This edge node's link key fingerprint
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此边缘节点的链路密钥指纹

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This instance gets its own copy of the shipped Constitution, which you can then edit. Organizations with their own document keep it.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此实例获得随附宪章的自己的副本，之后可以编辑。已有自己文档的组织会保留该文档。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This instance's own Constitution is removed and the shipped one applies to every agent run that starts from now on. The trusted reference origins stay as they are.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此实例自己的宪章将被移除，随附宪章应用于此后开始的每次智能体运行。受信任的引用来源保持不变。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This node has no enabled trunk yet. The trunks set up here go to the edge node and register from there.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此节点还没有已启用的中继。在此设置的中继会到边缘节点，并从那里注册。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This node is an edge node. Local nodes pair with it in Edge Clients.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此节点是边缘节点。本地节点在边缘客户端中与它配对。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This node is not paired with an edge node. An edge node is a small server in the cloud that gives this node a public presence. This node dials out to it and keeps one link open, so it needs no open port or fixed address.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此节点尚未与边缘节点配对。边缘节点是云中的小型服务器，为此节点提供公开存在。此节点向外拨号并保持一条链路，因此不需要开放端口或固定地址。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This node is paired with ${pairedName}. Unpair it first to pair with another edge node.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此节点已与 ${pairedName} 配对。要与另一个边缘节点配对，请先取消配对。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This node runs no XMPP server with a public domain: set xmpp_domain
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此节点没有带公开域的 XMPP 服务器：请设置 xmpp_domain

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This node runs no XMPP server: set xmpp_domain
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此节点未运行 XMPP 服务器：请设置 xmpp_domain

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This node stops when the edge node's link key no longer matches its pin, and the edge node refuses this node when it was revoked there. Unpair, make a new pairing code on the edge node, and pair again.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 当边缘节点的链路密钥不再匹配其固定值时，此节点会停止；若在边缘节点上撤销了此节点，边缘节点会拒绝它。请取消配对，在边缘节点上新建配对码，然后再次配对。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This node's trunks and phones through the edge node's SIP engine
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此节点的中继和电话经边缘节点的 SIP 引擎

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This node's trunks register from the edge node's SIP engine, and outside phones register to its registrar
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此节点的中继从边缘节点的 SIP 引擎注册，外部电话向其注册器注册

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This node's trunks register from the edge node's SIP engine, which takes their calls and asks this node how to route each; phones outside the office register to its registrar. Off, the trunks and fallbacks are not sent to it
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此节点的中继从边缘节点的 SIP 引擎注册，该引擎接听其通话并向此节点询问每通的路由；办公室外的电话向其注册器注册。关闭时，不向它发送中继和回退

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This replaces the override now in force and sets a new expiry.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 这会替换当前生效的覆盖，并设置新的到期时间。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This run has no error file
This working clone has changes that are not committed or not pushed. Remove moves the directory to .removed/ beside it, with the changes.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此工作克隆有未提交或未推送的更改。移除会把该目录连同更改移到旁边的 .removed/。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Thread details are unavailable on this server.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此服务器上无法查看线程详情。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Traces with LLM calls (OTel gen_ai.* spans): calls, token use, models and errors per trace, named by the agent, gateway or assist frame that made them. Prompts and replies are never recorded. Missing traces may reflect sampling or telemetry loss.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 含 LLM 调用的追踪（OTel gen_ai.* 跨度）：每次追踪的调用、token 用量、模型和错误，按产生它们的智能体、网关或协助帧命名。从不记录提示和回复。缺失的追踪可能来自抽样或遥测丢失。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Turn on at least one area
Tx Ignore: ${sd.txIgnore}, Force New: ${sd.txForceNew}, Use Tx Cache: ${sd.txUseCache}, Timeout: ${sd.txTimeout != null ? sd.txTimeout : ec.l10n.localize('Default')}
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 忽略事务：${sd.txIgnore}，强制新建：${sd.txForceNew}，使用事务缓存：${sd.txUseCache}，超时：${sd.txTimeout != null ? sd.txTimeout : ec.l10n.localize('Default')}

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Type the database name (${confirmation.confirmDatabaseName}) to run on this production server
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 输入数据库名称（${confirmation.confirmDatabaseName}）以在此生产服务器上运行

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Use ISO dates and times including Z or an explicit UTC offset. Silences suppress notifications while evaluation and state history continue.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 使用包含 Z 或明确 UTC 偏移的 ISO 日期和时间。静默抑制通知，评估和状态历史继续。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: User/group ID for this in-app notification.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此应用内通知的用户或组 ID。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Vacuum full and cluster lock each table for reads and writes until it is rewritten
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: Vacuum full 和 cluster 会锁定每张表的读写，直到重写完成

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: What an agent does to follow it
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 智能体为遵循它所做的事

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: What the database itself counted for each statement, from every instance and every client, the most costly first. Times are in milliseconds.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 数据库自身为每条语句统计的数据，来自每个实例和每个客户端，最耗时的在前。时间单位为毫秒。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: What the node's own setup, from its Edge Node wizard, set besides its host names
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 节点自己的设置（来自其边缘节点向导）除主机名之外所设置的内容

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: What the rule means for people
What the Tools can do on this database
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 工具在此数据库上可以做什么

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: What this node uses the edge node for
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此节点使用边缘节点的用途

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Where new calls have their media: the edge node's media node, with its TURN for outside browsers
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 新通话的媒体所在处：边缘节点的媒体节点，外部浏览器使用其 TURN

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Where the guidance comes from; shown to readers, not to agents
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 指导的来源；展示给读者，不展示给智能体

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Why not, or what limits it

With calls on, every new call has its media on the edge node, so office users in a call with each other send it to the cloud and back. There is no cascading to a media node of this node's own, and one local node per edge node takes calls.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 通话开启时，每个新通话的媒体都在边缘节点上，因此办公室里互相通话的用户会把它发到云端再传回。不能级联到此节点自己的媒体节点，且每个边缘节点只有一个本地节点接听通话。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: With empty label matchers {}, this silence affects only rules that reference it. With matchers, it can also affect matching rules whose owners can read it, even without a reference.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 标签匹配器 {} 为空时，此静默只影响引用它的规则。有匹配器时，它也能影响所有者可以阅读它的匹配规则，即使没有引用。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: With search-facade postgres partition-telemetry on, retention drops whole days of spans, logs, metrics and annotations. Tables made before it was on stay unpartitioned until they are moved here; the move copies their rows and keeps the old table to drop.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 在 search-facade postgres partition-telemetry 开启时，保留会丢掉整天的跨度、日志、指标和注释。开启之前建立的表保持未分区，直到移到这里；移动会复制其行并保留旧表待删除。
